summary: AMETEK filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an unsecured senior notes offering denominated in Canadian dollars to accredited Canadian investors on a private-placement basis, with BofA Securities and J.P. Morgan as joint book-running managers. Proceeds, alongside concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and commercial paper used to fund the roughly $5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, a purchase agreement signed May 5, 2026 and closed August 26, 2026. Notes carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase right; the offering itself is routine debt financing rather than a special situation, though deleveraging progress and leverage metrics bear watching.
